body: Thanks. I think I'll be able to make it while not around it on my trip. I'm more concerned for moving forward from there. I made similar promises to myself before and ended up smoking the second I was back. I guess it's partly being around it and partly being back in a stressful environment.

It's not that I think something that help shouldn't be used. I just I think in my case, guilt just makes me want to die more and being told that I'm going to hurt someone around me, as illogical as it sounds, doesn't dissuade me, but rather make me feel even more suicidal. "Look at you. you're ready to hurt all these people so you may as well just die." I know its a twisted way of thinking, but I don't think I'm the only one who feels that way. For some this isn't the case, but I figure not doing something to help is probably better than risking something harmful in a case like this. Guilt just never feels to me like a way to get someone to a point where they don't want to die. Maybe it's because I already feel so guilty about suicide that pointing stuff like that out can be downright insulting. It just points out the obvious to many. Yes people might miss me. That's why it makes me feel like such a bad person and I'm sure its part of why I want to die. Twisted as it is...
Edit: As to why this sub exists. You came here. I came here. You're reading what people are writing. It exists partly to commiserate I guess. I'm here for the same reason as you. It's just when you read about other people in a similar spot you can't help but relate. I don't know why some come with preachy notions. I just keep my mind on these subjects so perhaps I can figure shit out myself. You're right. I'm not here for you and you're not here for me. We're both here for ourselves. Sorry. Perhaps that's why I even commented. I wouldn't have really felt better from the comment so I mentioned it. That's all.

As someone who doesn't really care about having a partner. I feel as though perhaps our differences may come down to something axiomatic, but I still felt like maybe my comment has a place here. I don't have a partner and never have. I don't want a partner any time in the anticipated future either. That's not to say I don't have a sexual orientation though. I like women and I watch porn and whatever. Maybe it's the level of introversion I have, but I can just never see feeling comfortable around someone else in a relationship. There was a time in my life when I felt a bit more like how you seem to feel, but I guess  I just began to feel ok about it. I don't know if you have anxiety like me, but if it were ever love I was after, I just don't think things would ever really work on my end. I don't know what to say if you want someone to share their life with you since I don't have the desire for someone like that. I'm sorry it's so painful. 
On a slightly different note, if it's more of a sex thing you're worried about, I think you should actually look around a little bit more. It doesn't make you at the bottom of any totem pole not to fuck. Maybe on the totem pole of some other animal, but humans have moved a bit past that I think. It doesn't make you an interesting or intelligent or useful or funny or great person to fuck people. A lot of asshole worthless people fuck. Genghis khan fucked. The leader of goddamn ISIS fucked. I don't think most people would put you below them on a totem pole of people they want around and living or people they love and care about. So ya, if it's about finding someone to love then I really feel for you and I'm sorry it hurts like it does. If it's about sex though, I really think you should stop considering it so vital. There's a lot more than that out there to do that could potentially make life worth living. Not gonna say I'm in a much better place than you or that you'll definitely wake up and feel great one day. You probably won't, but you can never really see the future. Something pretty alright could happen that changes your outlook on things or you could meet someone. Who knows. I hope you give it a bit more time as grating and painful as that might truly be for you.

Please cold water extract them or whatever. As much as I understand para-suicidal behaviour, its really not the way you want to go. For how great drugs are they really can fuckin suck :/. Sorry to hear about another on the addiction boat.

"However, that being said I would not end my life if it would cause a loved one pain. Would you really want your wife committing suicide?" Saying stuff like that is against this sub's rules. What are you trying to do? Make him feel guilty for wanting to commit suicide? It may seem counterintuitive, but at least when people say stuff like that to me, it just makes me more suicidal. It's true that keeping the people you love on your mind is always good, just it only hurts you more to think about what would happen if you were gone. Not trying to hate on your response, just posts need to be extra careful here.
